result.title: Evaluation-Guided Demonstration Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Policies: The Winning Entry in the MetaFine Open Competition
result.comment: 1st place in the MetaFine Open Competition, RoboFineMani Workshop @ CoRL 2026
result.summary: We fine-tuned a separate $π_{0.5}$ policy for each of the five tasks in the MetaFine Open Competition, with a task-specific training mixture and number of actions executed per prediction. Training started from the official demonstrations and expert procedures. Local evaluation exposed recurring grasping, pushing, and insertion failures. We addressed them by revising the demonstrated motions and by adding expert continuations from states the policy reached, while keeping nominal demonstrations in training. Checkpoints were compared on every instruction, so that a gain on one instruction could not hide a loss on another. Our submission, MAI, ranked first overall with a score of 96.66.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为 MetaFine 竞赛的五个机器人任务分别微调 π0.5 策略并配置任务专属数据混合与执行步数，依据本地评估暴露的抓取、推动、插入失败来修订示范动作、补入从策略实际到达状态出发的专家续接数据，并逐指令比较 checkpoint，最终以 96.66 分排名第一。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「评估驱动示范修订＋从策略到达状态补专家续接」的监督数据筛选，以及逐指令细粒度验证以防收益掩盖损失的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练与贡献分配提供可供核查的线索，但对象是动作策略而非 latent 推理状态。
